params.note_text: Earlier today the person said: {claim} If it fits, ask lightly how they are now -- once -- and then follow their lead.

enabled.description: D58 followup (GH #1479): `1` or true = the cell hears the section `memory` the children hand out on `sidecar` and asks after an open concern of the person once: the newest fact of the day classed `wellbeing: true` (memory-hive schema, GH #1456) goes as ONE note of scope `once` with a `receipt` and `until` = the end of the person's day to the curator of every child -- at once to the surface that did not hear it, and to the hearing surface and the reasoning core `./cogny` (which the hearing session consults) only when that session ends (its curator's `write`); the first receipt closes it and every other copy is withdrawn, a copy still held is never sent. `0` (shipped) = nothing read, written or sent.

min_confidence.description: The least `confidence` of a classed fact that opens a concern (at least, not above). A fact without a confidence passes (OR-d38-3.v.9); a confidence that is no number does not. The preset of the curator's former `wellbeing_min_confidence`.

note_text.default: Earlier today the person said: {claim} If it fits, ask lightly how they are now -- once -- and then follow their lead.
note_text.description: The text form of the note: `{claim}` is the fact's claim, `{subject}` and `{predicate}` its subject and predicate; nothing else is replaced.

timezone.description: The instance's time zone (IANA name): the person's day, and so the key of the concern and the note's `until`, is a day in it. "" or an unknown zone = UTC (the latter said on stderr). The set sets it like the curator's.

now_utc.description: The cell's test clock: an RFC 3339 instant that stands for now. "" (shipped) = the wall clock.

description.purpose: Asks after an open concern of the person once (D58 followup, GH #1479; the rule left the curator, which knows no domain, R-58-9 Nr. 3). It hears the section `memory` each child of `assistant` hands out on `sidecar`, keeps the newest fact of the person's day classed `wellbeing: true` above `min_confidence` in its own store `./followup_store`, and sends it as a note of scope `once` with a `receipt` and `until` = the end of that day to the curator of every child (`in_note`): at once to the surface that did not hear it, and to the hearing surface -- the one `context.channel_node` names, `chat` = `./talky-chat`, else `./talky` -- and to `./cogny`, which that session consults, only when the session that heard it ends, on the `write` its curator hands out at every close (`in_note_held`; that session has it in its conversation already). The edges of `assistant` make the split: an `in_note` that names a hearing surface reaches the other surface only, `in_note_held` the hearing surface and `./cogny`, an `in_note` that names none (a withdrawal, a concern heard outside a session) every child. A concern heard outside a session goes everywhere at once. The first `note_receipt` that names it closes it, and every other copy is withdrawn (same id, text ""); a copy still held is then never sent. The same claim the same day opens nothing again, unless it is held for another session (then it is replaced like a different one); a different one replaces it (a note already out is withdrawn). Every write sweeps the rows of past days. It reads no ledger and no foreign database. Shipped off (`enabled` "0").
